env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A const-switch interface case whose select receive target holds an option
# fallback (`??`) inside a call argument: wrapSelectors drains the fallback's
# lowering into the cast splice, and the clause rewrite must fold the frozen
# operands into that composed cast text instead of re-reading the raw gaps.
# Ejected Go must parse and behave like the native build (issue thread B4).

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/constswitch_select_opt.lgo a/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/constswitch_select_opt_noindex.lgo b/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/constswitch_select_opt_noopt.lgo c/main.lgo

cd a
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/constswitch_select_opt.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! exists out/main.lgo
! grep -n '??' out/main.go
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/constswitch_select_opt.out
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

cd b
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/constswitch_select_opt_noindex.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! grep -n '??' out/main.go
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/constswitch_select_opt_noindex.out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

cd c
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/constswitch_select_opt_noopt.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/constswitch_select_opt_noopt.out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/cswselectopta

go 1.27
-- b/go.mod --
module example.com/cswselectoptb

go 1.27
-- c/go.mod --
module example.com/cswselectoptc

go 1.27
